Use the sign’s direction, places and colour to describe a lost object or a person. The lagna lord {lord} points {lordDir}. A study aid, not a forecast.

planet.readingNote: Avasthas: Deepta, Swastha, Mudita, Deena and Khala from the sign (friend and enemy by praśna group friendship); Shanta when at least 4 of 6 shadvarga signs are owned by benefics; Shakta when visible, Peedita when combust, Bheeta within 10° of the Sun; Vikala when joined with a malefic; Khala also for the loser of a planetary war (within 1°, the northern planet wins). Rahu and Ketu are left out because schools differ.

arudha.intro: Fix the Arudha Lagna by one of the classical methods, then read it against the cast chart.

hint.number: Ask the querist for any number from 1 to 108. Divide by 9: the quotient plus one is the Arudha sign, the remainder the navamsha running.
hint.letter: Note the first letter the querist speaks. Letters in odd columns give the planet's odd sign, even columns its even sign.
hint.chakra: The querist touches a square or places gold on it. Its block is the Arudha sign and the number the navamsha. The signs are not written; the astrologer knows them.
hint.lines: Draw three vertical and three horizontal lines without numbers. The end the querist touches is the Arudha.
hint.direction: The direction from which the querist approaches the astrologer gives the Arudha.

arudha.numberInvalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to 108.
arudha.letterBenefic: A benefic's letter: favourable results follow.
arudha.letterMalefic: A malefic's letter: unfavourable results follow.
arudha.pickHint: Or pick the Arudha sign directly:
arudha.castHint: Cast a prashna chart to read the sutra, Chatra Lagna and signs of a sincere query.
arudha.needArudha: Fix the Arudha above to see the sutra and Chatra Lagna.
arudha.sutraLine: Udaya lord {u} and Arudha lord {a} are {kind}.
arudha.chatraLine: Sun in {sun} gives veethi rashi {veethi}. From the Arudha to the Udaya Lagna is {count}; {count} from {veethi} is {chatra}.
arudha.same: Udaya and Arudha fall in the same sign, as they do in sincere queries.
arudha.sinceritySummary: Present now: {insincere} signs of an insincere query, {sincere} of a sincere one.
arudha.sincerityNote: In sincere queries the prashna Lagna also often matches the birth Lagna or Moon sign; compare with the birth chart if you have it.
arudha.ashtaHint: Three heaps of cowries with the eights taken out: left heap is the hundreds (past), middle the tens (present), right the ones (future). Without the ritual, ask for a number from 111 to 888.
arudha.ashtaInvalid: Use three digits, each from 1 to 8.
arudha.ashtaStrength: Weigh each result by that planet's strength in the prashna chart.
arudha.ashtaTable: Remainder, planet, yoni, animal and element
arudha.sheetIntro: Every Arudha method and rule in one place. Tap a card to see them as a mind map.

sheet.numberRule: Divide by 9: quotient + 1 = sign, remainder = navamsha
sheet.chatraSteps: Count from the Arudha to the Udaya Lagna, then count as far from the veethi rashi

ai.title: Download this prashna as a prompt file for Claude, ChatGPT or any AI
ai.heading: Ask any AI about this prashna
ai.body: Downloads the question, the moment, panchang and hora, the chart, and every Prashna Essentials reading (Lagna traits, avasthas, dignities, dhatu-mula-jeeva, mrityu and pushkara bhaga) as one Markdown file to attach in an AI chat, with praśna rules for the AI to follow.
ai.noQuestion: No question is written. Type it in the question box first, or the AI will ask you for it.
ai.shortHint: The chart and readings only (a few KB). Use this if the AI says the file is too long.
ai.fullHint: Adds what each house covers in praśna, so the AI can pick the right house for your question.
ai.hideQuestion: Leave out the question (tell the AI yourself)
ai.privacy: The prompt includes the date, time, place and your question. It goes to the AI provider you upload it to, under their privacy terms.

tajika.title: Tajika yogas
tajika.sub: Nīlakaṇṭha's sixteen yogas between the querist and the matter, read from this chart.
tajika.sameLord: One planet rules both the lagna and the matter, so there is no pair to join.
tajika.none: No Tajika yoga forms between these significators.
tajika.linksEmpty: No ithasala or ishrafa between any two planets.
tajika.note: Fast planet first. A study aid from classical Tajika, not a forecast.
tajika.wheelAria: Tajika chart: the seven planets with their ithasala, bhaviṣyat ithasala and ishrafa links
tajika.wheelHint: Lagna on the left. Hover a yoga or a link to pick out its planets.
tajika.sahamNote: A − B + C, reversed by night for most; +30° when C is not between B and A. Equal-house cusps from the lagna degree. Hover to mark a saham on the chart.

bala.note: Sum of the five over 4. 10 and above is strong, below 5 weak. Own lord gives full points, a friend half, neutral a quarter, an enemy an eighth (Parashari natural friendship). The yogas use this strength.

tajika.gridHint: Lines join the planets, whatever their degree inside the sign. Hover a yoga or a link to pick out its planets.

question.title: Question guide
question.sub: What to examine for each kind of question, read from this chart.
question.genuineNo: Moon and lagna lord not tied to the question houses.
question.genuineHint: The question may be vague, or not what the querent really has in mind. Check before answering.
question.checklistNote: Never drop the lagna and lagna lord, whatever the question. Read each house's lord, sign and planets, then the aspects and the Tajika yogas below.
question.twelveIntro: Cast only when a question is actually asked. For further questions on a different topic from the same chart, the reference point moves: question 1 reads from the D1 lagna, question 2 from the D9 lagna, and so on. Count the matter's house from the point for that question.
question.twelveNote: Up to 12 questions. Stronger or weaker of Venus and Mercury is by pañcavargīya bala. Once the questions are done, the chart is finished.
question.lostOnly: These clues are meant for a lost or stolen item question.
question.lostNote: From the class rules and case studies: D1 lagna for who, D9 lagna for where, Mars for theft, Saturn for servants and iron, the Moon for the mind on the loss. Answer insider-or-outsider questions with great care.
